analysis_registration: Retrospective secondary diagnostic frozen before this diagnostic execution; not precollection preregistration.
arithmetic: Selected JSON decimal tokens parsed as Decimal and converted to Fraction; exact saved scalar signs/equality and five-repeat means; no epsilon, clipping or target rounding.

interpretation.across_prompt_limit: Most pairs compare different originating prompts. This follows the historical across-item rank-sensitivity basis, not a controlled same-prompt preference task.
interpretation.cohort_limit: Items and HBQ rubric version change jointly between cohorts; no pooled primary HBQ estimate or causal version effect.
interpretation.dependence_limit: Pairs share items/prompts; repetitions are logical schedule indices, not independent human judges. Leave-cluster-out ranges describe sensitivity, not sampling confidence.
interpretation.genre_limit: Historical compact/holistic speculative-fiction anchors have an established applicability mismatch with some general-fiction originating prompts; this analysis cannot repair it.
interpretation.human_reference: Published HANNA human_overall: mean of six dimension means from three ratings each. Scalar ordering and ties refer to the retained aggregate convention, not human indifference.
interpretation.inherited_provenance: Saved scalar/reference bindings reused; no source prose, raw-rating, response, native or semantic replay; historical tool declarations remain uncertified.

missingness: Fail closed on any missing/duplicate arm, item, repetition, changed commitment, reference disagreement, or cohort mismatch; never filter pairs by observed outcome.
pair_convention: Every unordered pair uses lexically sorted fixed item identities; signs are left-minus-right. Input order cannot change the table. Correct/wrong classifications compare signs; no outcome-based pair selection.
privacy: Aggregate report only: no item identifiers, per-item scores/human targets, prompt hashes, private locators or case response bodies.
rates: Correct and wrong rates use all strict-reference pairs, including model ties; strict-reference directional coverage counts correct+wrong. All-pair directional coverage additionally counts model directions on human-tied pairs. Zero denominators are null; ties are never correct or human indifference.

sensitivity.denominators: Recalculate remaining pair and strict-reference denominators for each omission; retain same/across-prompt splits and undefined rates.
sensitivity.omission_identity: Ordinal in sorted opaque prompt-hash order; no hashes or item IDs emitted.
